name: Saguaro Lane Property Co. (fictional)
reviews: Left three voicemails about a leak and got no call back for a week, then it took 5 days to send anyone.
Our manager Dana is kind once you reach her and the portal is easy to use.

name: Copper Mesa Rentals (fictional)
reviews: Never had a delay with any repair, and every call is answered by a real person.
Leasing was quick and the team is not slow to reply to email.

name: Desert Key Homes Franchise Office (fictional)
reviews: Radio silence after move-in, nobody answered our maintenance tickets.
Inspection went smoothly and the report was clear.

name: Ironwood Residential (fictional)
reviews: The application portal kept erroring out on my phone.
Large team, very professional, lots of available homes.

name: Palo Verde Property Care (fictional)
reviews: Most agencies would not get back to me or would cancel showings, but Palo Verde called back the same day.
They handled our move-out walkthrough fairly.

name: Sunbelt Leasing Partners (fictional)
reviews: It took 6 days to hear anything about our application.
